plan.name: Show shell commands privately on act
plan.summary: Add a page-local Show shell commands toggle on /act, off on every page load, which shows each running step's shell invocations verbatim with their existing kind and start/end times beside its activity strip; switching it off, losing Access, or replacing or ending a step clears its command display, and late responses cannot restore it. Only GET /act/api/live.json?commands=1 adds per-step commands to the ordinary live envelope after the existing Cloudflare Access signed-token check, with no-store responses: the default private response, every public response and the agent listener remain free of command text, including after private reads warm the cache. The watcher gives every actual draft or build invocation its own directory even for same-second retries, publishes its basename as Step.Run (status JSON run) only after creation and before starting the agent, carries it through the watch command into status, and clears it when a new step starts; both the public strip and private commands read only that named run under the selected watcher and issue, treating names as opaque and never choosing by timestamps or falling back when the run or transcript is absent, while existing live test fixtures gain explicit run identities. Preserve both agents' incremental whole-event reads, overlapping calls, completion-only events and watcher selection, retaining command text only for the bounded recent marks the strip retains, displaying it as inert text and never including tool output or reasoning, with the public presentation otherwise unchanged. Update SPEC.md and README.md for the explicit run selection, opt-in private view and unchanged public restriction, citing D-0051, D-0065, D-0116, D-0136, D-0159 and D-0160 on the changed SPEC bullets as applicable; the private retention and display exception needs a new recorded decision, which whoever merges this plumbing change must record and cite since the build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsKeepExactTextKindsAndTimes
tests.says: The opted-in private live response lists each shell call from either agent exactly as recorded, once, with its public kind and its own start and end, including overlapping and completion-only calls, and excludes other tools, output and reasoning.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsStayBehindAccess
tests.says: Only a fresh signed owner token and explicit opt-in on the private live route reveal commands; public responses, default private responses, denied requests and the agent listener never reveal them, even after authenticated reads.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsFollowWholeEventsAndCurrentStep
tests.says: The private list reads only complete new transcript events, updates an invocation when its matching result arrives, remains stable across polls, resets when the transcript is truncated or a newly published run replaces it, and drops command text when the step ends.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsWaitForTheCurrentRunTranscript
tests.says: For either agent and every running step kind, publishing retry status without a run before creating its directory exposes no previous commands or current strip activity through warm or fresh readers; only the explicitly published run supplies both views after its transcript exists.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsFollowEverySelectedWatcher
tests.says: Commands belong to their own repository, issue and run, and use the same selected watcher and step order as the public activity strips, including concurrent steps and a change of lease holder.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsRetainOnlyTheStripWindow
tests.says: Private command history is bounded to the public strip's retained marks, and trimming old marks does not attach an old result or command to a different invocation.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandControlStartsOff
tests.says: The authenticated page serves a labelled unchecked Show shell commands control and an initially hidden output area beside each strip; the public page has no command toggle, and loading either page embeds no command text.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsUseRunIdentityAcrossTimeZones
tests.says: With directory names in watcher time zones east and west of the dashboard's UTC status times, neither view reuses previous activity while a retry waits for its run, and both accept the current named transcript regardless of its apparent time.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsUseRunIdentityForSameSecondRetries
tests.says: A retry within the previous run's second shows neither its commands nor its activity as current, even with reused tool IDs and a lexically later old directory; both views follow only the newly published run.

tests.name: TestLiveStripUsesOnlyTheStatusRun
tests.says: The public strip changes to the explicitly named run even with identical issue, step, start and agent, and never falls back to another directory when run is empty or its directory or transcript is missing.

tests.name: TestFactoryPublishesExplicitRunBeforeEveryDraft
tests.says: Initial drafts, answers and revisions each announce no run first, then publish their own existing directory before the agent starts, even at the same instant in a non-UTC watcher timezone.

tests.name: TestFactoryRetryUsesFreshRunForModeledBuild
tests.says: A stopped modeled build and its same-second retry publish distinct existing run directories before their agents start, clear run at the new step, and preserve the earlier transcript.

tests.name: TestFactoryRetryUsesFreshRunForPlumbingBuild
tests.says: A stopped plumbing build and its same-second retry publish distinct existing run directories before their agents start, clear run at the new step, and preserve the earlier transcript.
